checks_passed.check: construction: terminal step, ksm, product, intermediates
checks_passed.what_was_verified: For all 32 records the ksm is the first entry of the first step's reactant_names, the product is the last step's product_name, and intermediates are exactly the products of all but the last step. In all 24 two-step records the step 1 product string appears verbatim among the terminal step's reactant_names, so chain order is correct and no chain is reversed.

Every one of the 32 pathways has at least one step whose yield is null, and overall_yield_pct is null in all 32, so the stated mechanical rule is obeyed exactly. The defect reported separately is that the rule discards the patent's own two-step yield, not that the rule was broken.

overall_purity_pct equals the terminal step's product_purity_pct in all 32 records, and each of the 20 example values was compared with the printed HPLC content on its own line: 98.7, 96.7, 95.8, 98.0, 98.2, 96.0, 97.8, 98.2, 96.5, 97.1, 96.6, 96.8, 95.3, 95.9, 94.6, 94.8, 97.5, 97.0, 95.5, 97.0. All 20 match.

chain_length:N equals the step count in all 32 records (24 twos, 8 ones). The four derived tags are the last four in every record, in the fixed order chain_length, branching, convergence, lcl. No record contains a duplicate tag, every step tag is present, the step tags form a first-seen-order prefix of the tag list, and every tag in the artifact matches category:value with a lowercase snake_case ASCII value.

All 54 reaction records are used, none dropped and none invented. Claims_Step 1 and Claims_Step 2 appear twice, in the Claims and the patent pathway; every other reaction appears once. For all 56 step slots the shared fields (reaction_class, reaction_class_confidence, named_reaction, mechanism_type, scale, is_one_pot, one_pot_steps, conditions, conditions_inherited, workup, purification, selectivity, process_control, compounds, molar_ratio_text, safety_notes, reactant_names, product_name, product_yield_pct, product_purity_pct, procedure_text) are byte-identical to the reaction record, and components equals reactant_names plus product_name in every case.

For all 20 examples the alkali metal of the Step 1 salt intermediate matches the base actually charged in the prose: sodium for Examples 1, 2, 3 and 4 (NaOH), 7 (sodium tert-butoxide), 9 (NaH), 11 (sodium metal) and 13 to 20 (cross-reference to Example 1); potassium for Examples 5 and 6 (KOH), 8 (potassium tert-butoxide), 10 (KH) and 12 (potassium metal). No pathway inherited a counterion from a drawing that contradicts the prose.

For all 32 pathways honest_uncertainty_flags covers the union of the constituent steps' validation_flags under a consistent mapping: no_conditions to no_conditions_for_any_step, cross_reference_unresolved to cross_reference_unresolved_in_chain, conditions_unresolved to conditions_unresolved_in_chain, drawing_text_conflict to drawing_text_conflict_in_chain, mass_balance_implausible to inconsistent_step_arithmetic, and the two reagent-drawing flags.
